messages.author: 2b0cf426db67d5a9
messages.subject: shinyapps.io server too slow?
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to upload my shiny app to this server. It works fine in my laptop or server, usually can be finished within 10 seconds. But in the shinyapps.io it needs at least 3-4 minutes to finish the same task. The CPU usage is about 15000000000 (not sure what this mean) and the memory usage is about 700MB. So I think it is related to the shinyapps.io server CPU usage? Any suggestion about it? I checked the paid services and seems nothing is provided for upgrading server CPU?
my app is at https://shilinzhao.shinyapps.io/rnaseqsamplesizeweb/

Thanks!

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: shinyapps.io server too slow?
parts:
The units of CPU usage are in nanoseconds.

When the application runs locally, how much memory does it consume?

The higher paid tiers have access to more memory. By default applications are limited to 1 GB, so if you are seeing memory usage approaching that, you could certainly try a larger instance type for improvement.

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: shinyapps.io server too slow?
parts:
The unit is nanoseconds. It is the amount of time that the application was consuming the CPU for the period of time of the measurement. The period of time will depend upon how zoomed out you are, but is no more fine grained than a minute.

1500 seconds over what period of time would tell you a percentage.

Is your application loading anything over a network?

Also, I see many errors in the Javascript console.
